title: reconciliation.mismatch
description: A discrepancy found by a run (SRS 4.1.3): for an address and an asset the three sums are given. The event raises the alert. The event ID: <runId>:<address>:<ETH or token contract>.

kind.description: chain_vs_invoices: the balance read from the chain differs from the sum of the transfers accounted in invoices. invoices_vs_ledger: the invoices differ from the ledger statement.

chainBalance.description: Balance of the address read from the node.

invoicesTotal.description: Sum of the accounted transfers in the invoices of the address (projection of invoice.events).

ledgerTotal.description: Sum of the receipt postings of the address in the ledger statement.
